name: HyperX Pulsefire Dart (receiver)
notes: 62-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface (interface 0) of a real HyperX Pulsefire Dart, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/santeri3700/hyperx_pulsefire_dart_reverse_engineering/blob/22d298dbb8b71fc54f8c43c54336f589dbf97a93/misc/usb_hid_report_descriptors_0951_16e1_wireless.txt#L14-L17. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
